ConnectionStrings.PostgreSQL: Change this to the connection string of the PostgreSQL database

RabbitMQ.Host: Change this to the host of the RabbitMQ server
RabbitMQ.User: Change this to the username of the RabbitMQ server
RabbitMQ.Password: Change this to the password of the RabbitMQ server

ApiGateway.BaseUrl: Change this to the base URL of the API Gateway
ApiGateway.NotifyEndpoint: Change this to the notify endpoint of the API Gateway
